svg.text: Thirteen biomes side by side, at fight distance, noon

Each panel is one 1,200-unit stretch of ground at the same scale, with a 75-unit grey figure for scale. Flat faceted colours with a keyline; the far land is a value ladder toward the haze; no gradients, no blur. Below each: ground, rock, vegetation, water and
sky horizon. Concept art for Rendering and VFX; no character art.
a faceted swell under a clean horizon; the sea owns mid blue
pale sand, a wet-sand band, a foam line; palms and dune grass
rolling meadow; scattered broadleaf trees, boulders, tufts
gold dry grass, flat-topped acacias, red earth showing,
dense broadleaf and fir; a green floor; a leaf-litter ground
tall layered canopy, buttress trunks, giant leaves, dark
shallow tea-green water, reed beds, mangrove roots, flat mud
long dunes with a steep lee, red mesas, cacti and scrub;
grey faceted rock, snow on the shade side, conifers low down,
black basalt, grey ash slopes, a cone with a rim, a few cooled
lava flows; the rocky highland in its cold state
grey-green lichen ground, snow in the hollows, dark spruce
two tones: a warm-white lit face and a cold slate face;
flat floes with a warm-white top and a slate edge in dark cold
